body:
This PR was created at the user's explicit request.

Purpose: prepare the instruction/prompt package for the **next round of four web-based GPT Pro research sessions plus selective GPT-5.6 Sol review**.

It adds only `research_prompts/next_round_4webpro_sol_20260918/`:

- `README.md` — origin, dispatch policy, and the four-task split.
- `COMMON.md` — shared mathematical target, evidence rules, counterexample/failed-route inheritance, finite-chord policy, and delivery requirements.
- `WEB_PRO_01_TRUE_BLOCK_REMAINDER.md` — actual-law full-block signed payment using the retained exact remainder and true rank-one reveal path.
- `WEB_PRO_02_GENERAL_DENSITY_OFF_MIDPOINT.md` — ordinary density and fixed off-midpoint high-contrast true-law theorem.
- `WEB_PRO_03_DYADIC_FINITE_CHORD.md` — true-law cross-scale payment for the retained signed dyadic finite-chord sum, inheriting the reviewed QWE02 tail.
- `WEB_PRO_04_HIGH_CONTRAST_ENDPOINT.md` — all-orders posterior/resummation route aimed directly at `c -> 1`.
- `SOL_PROTOCOL.md` — selective use of Sol: do not automatically spend one reviewer per Pro; reserve review capacity for results that can change the research allocation and for final composition.

The prompts explicitly tell the next round to read the newest S59/S60/S61 dispositions before starting and to inherit accepted progress rather than duplicate it. The shared/public counterexample and failed-route area is referenced rather than copied.

Scope boundary: this is an instruction-only PR. It does not launch agents, alter README/PROGRESS/STATIONARY_STATUS, change any accepted theorem status, or promote pending author claims.
title: Prepare next-round prompts for four Web Pro researchers and Sol review
